text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's been a while since I've had a day off, 
so I decide to go shopping 
for some 
essentials. I bump into a familiar face at 
the mall.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Sob, sob...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
There, there. I'm sure it was scary, right? 
But everything's gonna be 
okay now.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Just wait here for a second, okay? I'll... 
umm...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Perfect timing—it seems like this 
little girl here got lost.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I found her crying in the corner by herself 
and tried to ask her what's 
wrong...

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Sob, sob...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Aw, was it scary being alone? There, there. 
It's okay now.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Umm... I... don't know... waaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Crap, I shouldn't have asked that question! 
She's bawling now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I quickly take out my handkerchief from 
my pocket and wipe the girl's 
face.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Sob, sob...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Aww, Trainer! Thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Your face is all cleaned up now. Isn't that 
nice? So tell me... were you 
out here 
shopping?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The little girl gives a small nod.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I see! What did you want to buy?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
I wanted... an Umagical Wand... because 
Papa and Mama said... 
they'd buy it for 
me...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Well, isn't that nice? You must've been 
excited! Does that mean you 
came here 
together with your Papa and Mama?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The little girl nods again. There's no doubt 
that she's lost. I pause, 
thinking about the 
best thing to do in this situation...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yes, please do. I'll stay here with her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I approach the desk, I see a husband 
and wife standing there, 
faces stricken 
with worry. They must be the girl's parents!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you so much for your help 
today. I'm so glad that little 
girl was able 
to reunite with her parents.
choice_data_list: I wasn't much help, was I?
I wasn't much help, was I?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No, really. Be proud of yourself—you were 
such a big help.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Until you showed up, I wasn't sure what I 
was going to do. I couldn't 
just walk away 
with the girl, so I thought about calling for 
help...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But there weren't any staff nearby either. 
Honestly, I felt stuck.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
So when you came, it was a huge relief. I 
was really happy to see you.
choice_data_list: Still, you made a girl cry.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, maybe it wouldn't hurt to learn a bit 
more about how to handle 
little kids.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But really though... I felt safe with you 
being there.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I appreciated having you with me, so 
please don't put yourself down.
choice_data_list: Am I a more reliable Trainer now?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
And you didn't forget your handkerchief 
this time. Good job! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I can't help myself though. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even though our dynamics haven't 
changed much, I feel that I was 
able to 
gain more of Super Creek's trust today.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: (I'm glad I can depend on you, Trainer.)
